E1278

A jetos activation proof is incomplete.

What

A jetos activation proof is incomplete.

Why

D-WD8 requires `jet os switch` to prove the plan, risk class, generated service artifacts, and rollback evidence before changing the active generation pointers.

Fix

Rebuild the generation so the proof artifacts are regenerated, or discard a hand-edited generation.
